programme.degree: Bachelor of Engineering, Department of Computer Science (情報工学系), School of Computing (情報理工学院)
programme.how_found: Department site educ.titech.ac.jp/cs; admissions facts from admissions.isct.ac.jp (privately funded international student special selection).
programme.notes: International route: 私費外国人留学生特別選抜 (EJU + university exam + interview); School of Computing quota 若干人 (a few). Official-domain note: kb_top100_list.json has official_domain null for this row; the university uses isct.ac.jp (www, admissions, students) and still serves the former Tokyo Tech department sites on titech.ac.jp (educ.titech.ac.jp/cs, footer "© Dept. of Computer Science, Institute of Science Tokyo"). Both need to be official for this case.

value.description: Programme taught in Japanese; Japanese proficiency required

english.quote: Lectures for bachelor’s degree programs at Science and Engineering fields (formerly Tokyo Tech) other than GSEP are conducted in Japanese.
english.notes: Not an English requirement: the language is Japanese (EJU Japanese section threshold, see gpa). The special selection includes an English written test (学力検査: 数学、物理、化学、英語、日本語), no external English test minimum read.

value.description: EJU 2026 thresholds: Japanese >= 290/450; science (physics, chemistry) and Mathematics Course 2 >= 310/400 — test scores, no school-grade minimum

gpa.quote: 日本語（記述、読解及び聴解・聴聴解） 理系３科目（物理、化学及び数学コース２） 450点満点中290点以上 400点満点中310点以上
gpa.notes: 令和9（2027）年度私費外国人留学生特別選抜: EJU (2026) score thresholds; table cells read in order (subjects, then thresholds).

deadline.notes: The application period is in the 令和9（2027）年度 募集要項 (PDF guideline), not read; the page gives first-stage results 1月6日（水） and the written test 1月20日（水） without a year.

tuition.notes: Columns: 検定料 17,000 / 入学料 282,000 / 授業料(半期) 317,700 / 授業料(年間) 635,400 yen; 理工学系 bachelor (2019年4月1日以降). "上記の額は改定されることがあります". No academic year printed.

value.name: Privately funded scholarships for international students (university-recommended and direct)

scholarship_exists.quote: Privately funded scholarships are divided into two types: one requires a recommendation from a university, and the other requires no recommendation.
scholarship_exists.notes: External foundation scholarships administered through the university for enrolled international students; competitive; amounts vary. Tuition exemption also exists (授業料免除). The titech.ac.jp Scholarship Finder renders by JavaScript (no list in readable text).
